body:
My First LSD Experience
So yeah I did it.... Nothing crazy happend, Ive felt the tingly feeling going up and down my body, as a matter of fact I still feel it now nearly 7 hours afterwards... As far as the visuals Ive only had one, nothing crazy but I had a good time. Hung out with my close circle of friends and met new people as well, walked around town listened to good music  and talked alotta nonsense.The funny thing is that it actually hit me now at 4 am, I dont know if it happend to anyone of you, but this sensation of feeling happy came over me, standnig by my rats cage while giving them food, looking around my room, looking at my guitar, and thinking about my dad... I cant describe it, I mean the closest to it is just to say  that I felt happy =)  I can honestly say that Ive had a good experience and it doesnt have to be as crazy and visual as some people experience it.... But it was that moment when it hit me, and as I have mentioned before Ive spend quality time with people that care about me as much as I care for them.... Its 416 Im gonna go to sleep Im rather tired hehe....
Well thats what I wrote before this part, but when it comes to the specifics, to help out other people here we go. Well it was a good group of close people, I persnally did it for the first time and a friend of mine did as well. The mindset for me was just plain simple I felt ready to experience it and I used the help of this great website for which Im very thankful. The setting was at my friends house in the backyard. Around 848pm thats when we took them, nothing crazy on my side from what other people have experienced as I mentioned in the essay (?) above. I just found myself to be really involved in playing the game of Jenga. As far any additives to it, all I did was just taking a huge bong hit, which in it essence killed me cause I havent smoked for a month Ive been clean and sober. So I dont think it could have contributed to it as much. So as Ive mentioned before, It hit me 7 hours after dropping the sugarcube and its all I have to say Nothing flashy, no crazy shit, just a feeling that nearly brought tears to my eyes.
Ive enjoyed my experience and Im no longer scared of the myth, Im looking forward for the hallucination and the whole experience, but atleast now I know how it feels I might be just babbling but if you read it, you might have the same experience as me one day, and dont take it for granted. Take care and be safe =)
